statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The clinical indication is concern for arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was based on missing required precertification or authorization
